local teleportDelay = 700 -- ЗАДЕРЖКА ТЕЛЕПОРТА (мс)

local ANGLE_2 = 25

local cycleThread = nil

local function Jump()
    local character = player.Character
    if character then
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
            humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
        end
    end
end

local function Attack()
    pcall(function()
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.Escape, false, game)
        task.wait(0.05)
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.Escape, false, game)
    end)
    task.wait(0.1)
    pcall(function()
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.Escape, false, game)
        task.wait(0.05)
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.Escape, false, game)
    end)
end

    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end
    local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    local angleRad = math.rad(ANGLE_2)
    root.CFrame = CFrame.new(POINT_2) * CFrame.Angles(0, angleRad, 0)

    if isRunning then return end
    isRunning = true
    cycleThread = task.spawn(function()

        isRunning = false

local function StopCycle()
    if not isRunning then return end

scripts.features: Noclip

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local disabled = {}
local floorY = nil
local floor = Instance.new("Part")
floor.Size = Vector3.new(10, 1, 10)
floor.Anchored = true
floor.CanQuery = false
floor.CanTouch = false
floor.Transparency = 1
floor.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera

local params = RaycastParams.new()
params.RespectCanCollide = true

local function check(part)
	if not part:IsA("BasePart") or not floorY then
		return
	end
	local cf, size = part.CFrame, part.Size
	local halfHeight = math.abs(cf.RightVector.Y) * size.X / 2
		+ math.abs(cf.UpVector.Y) * size.Y / 2
		+ math.abs(cf.LookVector.Y) * size.Z / 2
	if cf.Position.Y + halfHeight > floorY + 1.5 then
		if part.CanCollide then
			disabled[part] = true
			part.CanCollide = false
		end
	elseif disabled[part] then
		disabled[part] = nil
		part.CanCollide = true
	end
end

local function scan()
	for _, name in ipairs({ "ActiveMaps", "Lobby" }) do
		local root = workspace:FindFirstChild(name)
		if root then
			for _, part in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
				check(part)
			end
		end
	end
end

local elapsed = 3
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	local char = player.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not (root and humanoid) then
		return
	end
	local height = humanoid.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char, workspace.CurrentCamera }
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, Vector3.new(0, -(height + 30), 0), params)
	floorY = hit and hit.Position.Y or floorY or root.Position.Y - height
	floor.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position.X, floorY - 0.5, root.Position.Z)
	elapsed = elapsed + dt
	if elapsed >= 3 then
		elapsed = 0
		scan()
	end
end)

scripts.title: Chat blocker for scripts that expose users in chat
scripts.features: You sometimes come across scripts that post the cheat's name in the chat for promotional purposes, which gives the user away, this script solves that problem
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

local env = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
env.__ChatBlocker = env.__ChatBlocker or { enabled = false, hooked = false }
local State = env.__ChatBlocker

if State.unload then
    pcall(State.unload)
end

local function isLegacyChatRemote(inst)
    return typeof(inst) == "Instance"
        and inst.ClassName == "RemoteEvent"
        and inst.Name == "SayMessageRequest"
end

local function isTextChannel(inst)
    return typeof(inst) == "Instance" and inst.ClassName == "TextChannel"
end

if not State.hooked then
    State.hooked = true

    if hookmetamethod and getnamecallmethod then
        local oldNamecall
        oldNamecall = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", newcclosure(function(self, ...)
            if State.enabled then
                local method = getnamecallmethod()
                if method == "FireServer" and isLegacyChatRemote(self) then
                    return
                end
                if method == "SendAsync" and isTextChannel(self) then
                    return
                end
            end
            return oldNamecall(self, ...)
        end))
    else
        warn("[ChatBlocker] executor has no hookmetamethod, namecall hook will not be installed")
    end

    if hookfunction then
        local function hookMethod(className, methodName, check)
            pcall(function()
                local dummy = Instance.new(className)
                local orig
                orig = hookfunction(dummy[methodName], newcclosure(function(self, ...)
                    if State.enabled and check(self) then
                        return
                    end
                    return orig(self, ...)
                end))
                dummy:Destroy()
            end)
        end

        hookMethod("RemoteEvent", "FireServer", isLegacyChatRemote)
        hookMethod("TextChannel", "SendAsync", isTextChannel)
    end
end

local function setInputBar(blocked)
    pcall(function()
        local cfg = TextChatService:FindFirstChildOfClass("ChatInputBarConfiguration")
        if not cfg then
            return
        end
        if blocked then
            if State.prevBar == nil then
                State.prevBar = cfg.Enabled
            end
            cfg.Enabled = false
        elseif State.prevBar ~= nil then
            cfg.Enabled = State.prevBar
            State.prevBar = nil
        end
    end)
end

local function getGuiParent()
    if gethui then
        local ok, ui = pcall(gethui)
        if ok and ui then
            return ui
        end
    end
    if pcall(function() return CoreGui:GetChildren() end) then
        return CoreGui
    end
    return Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "ChatBlockerGui"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
if syn and syn.protect_gui then
    pcall(syn.protect_gui, gui)
end
gui.Parent = getGuiParent()

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Name = "Main"
frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 112)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -110, 0.3, 0)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 34)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.Parent = gui
Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Name = "Title"
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 50)
title.BorderSizePixel = 0
title.Text = "  Chat Blocker"
title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 240)
title.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
title.TextSize = 18
title.Parent = frame
Instance.new("UICorner", title).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
closeBtn.Name = "Close"
closeBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30)
closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 0)
closeBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
closeBtn.Text = "X"
closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 90, 90)
closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
closeBtn.TextSize = 18
closeBtn.Parent = title

local toggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggle.Name = "Toggle"
toggle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 40)
toggle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 42)
toggle.BorderSizePixel = 0
toggle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
toggle.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
toggle.TextSize = 20
toggle.AutoButtonColor = true
toggle.Parent = frame
Instance.new("UICorner", toggle).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

local hint = Instance.new("TextLabel")
hint.Name = "Hint"
hint.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 18)
hint.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 88)
hint.BackgroundTransparency = 1
hint.Text = "RShift - hide / show"
hint.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 140)
hint.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
hint.TextSize = 14
hint.Parent = frame

local function refresh()
    if State.enabled then
        toggle.Text = "Chat: BLOCKED"
        toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 160, 90)
    else
        toggle.Text = "Chat: ALLOWED"
        toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 55, 55)
    end
end

local function setBlocked(value)
    State.enabled = value
    setInputBar(value)
    refresh()
end

local conns = {}
local function connect(signal, fn)
    local c = signal:Connect(fn)
    table.insert(conns, c)
    return c
end

local dragging, dragStart, startPos, dragInput

connect(title.InputBegan, function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = frame.Position
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

connect(title.InputChanged, function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

connect(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(input)
    if dragging and input == dragInput then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        frame.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

local function unload()
    State.enabled = false
    setInputBar(false)
    for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
        pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
    end
    if gui then
        gui:Destroy()
    end
    State.unload = nil
end
State.unload = unload

connect(toggle.MouseButton1Click, function()
    setBlocked(not State.enabled)
end)

connect(closeBtn.MouseButton1Click, unload)

connect(UserInputService.InputBegan, function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then
        return
    end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
        frame.Visible = not frame.Visible
    end
end)

            )

            if flatLook.Magnitude > 0 then
                flatLook = flatLook.Unit
            end

            if flatRight.Magnitude > 0 then
                flatRight = flatRight.Unit
            end

            if move.Magnitude > 0 then
                local forwardAmount = move:Dot(flatLook)
                local rightAmount = move:Dot(flatRight)

                direction =
                    look * forwardAmount
                    + flatRight * rightAmount
            end

            -- TECLADO DO PC

local function getClosestPlayer()
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not myChar then return nil end
    local myHRP = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myHRP then return nil end

    local closest, closestDist = nil, math.huge

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
-- CONTROLADOR FLUIDO
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
local activeController = nil

local FADE = 0.15
local IDLE_CYCLE_TIME = 5
local FALL_VELOCITY_THRESHOLD = -10

local function stopController()
    if not activeController then return end
    for _, conn in ipairs(activeController.connections) do
        pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
    end
    for _, track in pairs(activeController.tracks) do
        pcall(function() if track then track:Stop(0.1) end end)
    end
    activeController = nil
end

local function applyCustomAnims(customData, nombre)
    if not customData then return end
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end
    local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
    if not animator then return end

    stopController()

    local animate = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
    if animate then animate.Disabled = true end

    for _, t in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
        pcall(function() t:Stop(FADE) end)
    end
    task.wait(FADE + 0.05)

    local function load(id, priority, looped)
        if not id then return nil end
        local a = Instance.new("Animation")
        a.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(id)
        local ok, t = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(a) end)
        if not ok or not t then return nil end
        t.Priority = priority
        t.Looped = looped
        return t
    end

    local P_IDLE = Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle
    local P_MOVE = Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement

    local tracks = {
        idle1    = load(customData.Idle, P_IDLE, true),
        idle2    = load(customData.Idle2 or customData.Idle, P_IDLE, true),
        walk     = load(customData.Walk, P_MOVE, true),
        run      = load(customData.Run or customData.Walk, P_MOVE, true),
        jump     = load(customData.Jump, P_MOVE, false),
        fall     = load(customData.Fall, P_MOVE, true),
        climb    = load(customData.Climb, P_MOVE, true),
        swim     = load(customData.Swim, P_MOVE, true),
        swimIdle = load(customData.SwimIdle or customData.Swim, P_IDLE, true),
    }

    local controller = {
        tracks = tracks,
        connections = {},
        currentState = nil,
        idleIndex = 1,
        data = customData,
        nombre = nombre or "Custom",
        char = char,
        hum = hum,
        alive = true
    }
    activeController = controller

    local function stopStateTracks(state)
        if state == "idle" then
            if tracks.idle1 and tracks.idle1.IsPlaying then pcall(function() tracks.idle1:Stop(FADE) end) end
            if tracks.idle2 and tracks.idle2.IsPlaying then pcall(function() tracks.idle2:Stop(FADE) end) end
        elseif state == "swimIdle" then
            if tracks.swimIdle and tracks.swimIdle.IsPlaying then pcall(function() tracks.swimIdle:Stop(FADE) end) end
        elseif state and tracks[state] and tracks[state].IsPlaying then
            pcall(function() tracks[state]:Stop(FADE) end)
        end
    end

    local function setState(newState)
        if controller.currentState == newState then return end
        local oldState = controller.currentState
        controller.currentState = newState

        if oldState then stopStateTracks(oldState) end

        if newState == "idle" then
            controller.idleIndex = 1
            if tracks.idle1 then pcall(function() tracks.idle1:Play(FADE) end) end
        elseif newState == "swimIdle" then
            if tracks.swimIdle then pcall(function() tracks.swimIdle:Play(FADE) end) end
        elseif tracks[newState] then
            pcall(function() tracks[newState]:Play(FADE) end)
        end
    end

    local function ajustarVelocidad()
        local vel = hum.WalkSpeed
        local factor = vel / 16
        if factor < 0.5 then factor = 0.5 end
        if factor > 3 then factor = 3 end

        if tracks.walk and tracks.walk.IsPlaying then
            pcall(function() tracks.walk:AdjustSpeed(factor) end)
        end
        if tracks.run and tracks.run.IsPlaying then
            pcall(function() tracks.run:AdjustSpeed(factor) end)
        end
    end

    -- ═══════════════════════════════════════
    -- UPDATE CON DETECCIÓN DE FALL POR VELOCIDAD
    -- ═══════════════════════════════════════
    local function update()
        if not controller.alive then return end
        if not char.Parent or hum.Health <= 0 then return end

        local state = hum:GetState()
        local moveDir = hum.MoveDirection
        local moving = moveDir.Magnitude > 0.1

        -- Detección de caída por velocidad vertical
        local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local velY = root and root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y or 0
        local cayendo = velY < FALL_VELOCITY_THRESHOLD

        local newState
        if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming then
            newState = moving and "swim" or "swimIdle"
        elseif state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing then
            newState = "climb"
        elseif cayendo then
            -- Prioridad alta: si está cayendo, mostrar fall
            newState = "fall"
        elseif state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
            newState = "jump"
        elseif state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
            newState = "fall"
        elseif moving then
            newState = hum.WalkSpeed >= 20 and "run" or "walk"
        else
            newState = "idle"
        end

        setState(newState)
        ajustarVelocidad()
    end

    table.insert(controller.connections, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(update))
    table.insert(controller.connections, hum.StateChanged:Connect(update))

    local function cycleIdle()
        if not controller.alive or activeController ~= controller then return end
        if controller.currentState == "idle" and tracks.idle1 and tracks.idle2 then
            if controller.idleIndex == 1 then
                if tracks.idle1.IsPlaying then tracks.idle1:Stop(0.4) end
                tracks.idle2:Play(0.4)
                controller.idleIndex = 2
            else
                if tracks.idle2.IsPlaying then tracks.idle2:Stop(0.4) end
                tracks.idle1:Play(0.4)
                controller.idleIndex = 1
            end
        end
        task.delay(IDLE_CYCLE_TIME, cycleIdle)
    end
    task.delay(IDLE_CYCLE_TIME, cycleIdle)

    table.insert(controller.connections, hum.Died:Connect(function()
        controller.alive = false
    end))

    if tracks.idle1 then pcall(function() tracks.idle1:Play(FADE) end) end
    controller.currentState = "idle"

    return controller
end
